result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where the bottom navigation bar lacks safe-area bottom padding and overlaps with the system home indicator.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar does not account for the device's bottom safe-area inset, causing the system home indicator bar to directly overlap the middle navigation icons (Search and Orders) and pushing all tab icons flush against the bottom edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding (e.g., env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) to the bottom navigation container so the icons sit cleanly above the system home indicator.
